verdict.rationale: Floot is an AI app-building platform with an MCP server, so asking whether its API is versioned and has a deprecation policy is a fair question. The evidence pack documents no API versioning scheme and no deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404, and the MCP tool docs say nothing about versions or deprecation timelines.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
